summary: Tested root URL routing, auth screen, PIN-only guest session flow, PIN setup, and vault access. All flows working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified working: root URL → /auth redirect (within ~2s), both Google and PIN-only buttons visible, PIN-only creates guest session via POST /api/auth/guest, navigates to /setup-pin, 4-digit PIN entry works, navigates to /home (vault) after confirmation. Backend guest endpoint returns session_token + user correctly.
rca_of_issue: The previously reported root URL navigation bug appears to be RESOLVED. The AppContext initAuth() completes quickly when no token is stored (no getMe() call needed), and the useEffect in index.tsx correctly triggers window.location.href='/auth'. Tested: navigated to / and was redirected to /auth within 3 seconds.
